Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune vs Homoeopathic Medical College Pune is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the BHMS classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune vs Homoeopathic Medical College Pune for BHMS: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune if you want a recorded fee of ₹1.76 lakh, and an admission route through NEET, in a private BHMS setting at Pune.
Choose Homoeopathic Medical College Pune if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, and an admission route through NEET, in a private BHMS setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹1.76 lakh as a tuition figure for Bachelor of Homeopathic System of Medicine and Surgery at Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune. Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Homoeopathic Medical College Pune that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

Homoeopathic Medical College Pune's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹12 LPA on Bachelor of Homeopathic System of Medicine and Surgery. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune is listed on our records with NEET as an admission route for this BHMS comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.

Homoeopathic Medical College Pune is listed on our records with NEET as an admission route for this BHMS comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded BHMS offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
If you want a documented flagship placement year, Homoeopathic Medical College Pune is the clearer record here, because Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune has no 2020-or-later flagship package on this page.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune or Homoeopathic Medical College Pune?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune and Homoeopathic Medical College Pune differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of BHMS classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune vs Homoeopathic Medical College Pune?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹1.76 lakh for Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune on Bachelor of Homeopathic System of Medicine and Surgery; we do not hold a quotable fee for Homoeopathic Medical College Pune on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune and Homoeopathic Medical College Pune?
faqs.answer: We do not hold a 2020-or-later flagship placement year for Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune here, so do not treat older or unofficial packages as current.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune and Homoeopathic Medical College Pune accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list NEET for Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune, and NEET for Homoeopathic Medical College Pune. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Bharati Vidyapeeth Pune and Homoeopathic Medical College Pune in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
